tierLegend.text: build essentials, incredibly powerful for damage or survivability
very strong and useful effects, but more on the supportive side
core parts of specific builds or scenarios, not always applicable
can be useful but in very niche builds or situations
technically beneficial but poor uptime or not very noticeable

records.name: Facet of Purpose
records.effect: x1 Bolt Charge (arc), Restoration x1 for 5s (solar), 22.5 HP Void Overshield for 5s (void), x2 Frost Armor for 5s (stasis), Woven Mail for 5s (strand)
records.usage: not very good on some supers but insane on the supers that matter (solar/void)

records.name: Echo of Starvation
records.usage: free heal and one of the strongest survivability effects on every orb pickup

records.name: Spark of Resistance
records.usage: free stackable 25% DR pretty much whenever it's needed

records.name: Ember of Benevolence
records.trigger: reviving, Cure, Radiant, or Restoration to ally
records.usage: basically permanently active massive regen buff on competent solar builds

records.name: Facet of Courage
records.effect: 10% light ability damage and +50% light melee damage to darkness-debuffed enemies
records.usage: free 10% to some of the strongest supers in the game, also works with some melee strategies

records.name: Thread of Evolution
records.effect: threadlings move 30% faster, ?% further, and gain 33% damage
records.usage: same logic as Courage — ~8% to super, free 33% increase to Weaver's Call too

records.name: Whisper of Rime
records.effect: increases Frost Armor max to x7 (50% DR), stack duration to 6s
records.usage: max DR from 31.25 to 50%, increases uptime too

records.name: Spark of Beacons
records.trigger: special/heavy arc weapon kills while Amplified
records.usage: no ICD blind on every kill if conditions met, insane uptime

records.name: Echo of Vigilance
records.usage: quite possibly the best emergency kill fragment for survivability

records.name: Facet of Protection
records.usage: downgrade from Resistance but still free 15% DR

records.name: Thread of Generation
records.usage: custom on-hit formula is mysterious but usually ends up giving a lot of grenade energy

records.name: Echo of Obscurity
records.usage: by far the best finisher fragment effect, great for resetting aggression during combat

records.name: Facet of Dominance
records.trigger:
void grenade damage
arc grenade damage (4s ICD for Arc Soul)
records.effect:
weaken for 6s on hit
jolt on hit
records.usage: same logic as Undermining — jolt frequency nerf is notable, but still deserving of A

records.name: Echo of Undermining
records.usage: neutral 15% increase to all damage if high uptime, debuff extension available too

records.name: Ember of Torches
records.usage: constant Radiant uptime on applicable subclasses

records.name: Ember of Char
records.usage: must-have for chaining ignitions with Fulmination and other ignition components

records.name: Whisper of Shards
records.effect: +500% grenade regen for 6s, extensions up to 11s
records.usage: most offensive stasis builds are melee-focused and have no uptime issues, usable for defensive builds

records.name: Whisper of Conduction
records.effect: stasis shards within 15m pulled to user after 1s
records.usage: purely QoL but of the best sort; pretty nice on stasis titan/hunter

records.name: Ember of Singeing
records.usage: very solid and high uptime class regen, also class as valuable as some other abilities

records.name: Ember of Ashes
records.usage: core pick for Dawn Chorus and other scorch builds

records.name: Spark of Shock
records.trigger: arc grenade damage (4s ICD for Arc Soul/Ionic Sentry)
records.usage: like Dominance without debuff/weaken, basically just for Arc Soul/Ionic Sentry and maybe Shinobu

records.name: Whisper of Torment
records.usage: free grenade returns, fairly significant given Frost Armor uptime due to artifact and stepped timer change

records.name: Whisper of Impetus
records.usage: restricted by poor stasis melee choices outside of stasis hunter, but still very potent for refills

records.name: Thread of Warding
records.usage: duration nerf hurts but still pretty high Woven Mail uptime given orb sandbox

records.name: Thread of Ascent
records.effect: refills readied weapon, 40? handling, 40? reload, 0.925x reload duration, 30 AE for 15s
records.usage: same ICD as Domineering and Command with much easier requirement, especially with Generation

records.name: Facet of Hope
records.usage: minor class regen increase but high uptime makes this a good filler pick for DPS or general roam

records.name: Facet of Dawn
records.trigger:
powered melee hit
powered melee kill
records.effect:
Radiant for 5s
Radiant for 5s for allies within ?m
records.usage: much worse uptime than Torches, also requires kill for allied benefit

records.name: Ember of Searing
records.usage: guarantees melee recovery without Heat Rises for warlock scorch builds

records.name: Echo of Persistence
records.effect: Devour/Void Overshield get 1.5x duration, Invisibility gets 1.4x duration
records.usage: extended Devour and Overshield always at least a little helpful

records.name: Ember of Solace
records.usage: more realistic survivability extension compared to Empyrean in current sandbox

records.name: Thread of Fury
records.usage: despite ICD, simultaneous hits work, tangle blast radius makes this give a lot of melee energy

records.name: Facet of Generosity
records.effect: up to 4 7.15% super orbs (at 3/5/7/10 minor kills)
records.usage: very strong for super chaining optimization in planned scenarios

records.name: Facet of Solitude
records.trigger: (20% of mag + 1 rounded down, 2 for bows) crits within 2s of each (4s ICD)
records.effect: 3m (6m while Transcendent) severing burst on next hit
records.usage: easy boss sever application source for survivability

records.name: Thread of Isolation
records.trigger: multiple crits within 2s of each (archetype-based, 4s ICD)
records.usage: easy boss sever application source for survivability

records.name: Spark of Frequency
records.effect:
15 stability, 50 reload, 0.8x reload duration for 5.25s
+1 stack to Bolt Charge sources
records.usage: doubled Bolt Charge for neutral arc builds

records.name: Whisper of Hunger
records.usage: pretty noticeable melee gains but additive nature means GoA armor can be used instead

records.name: Spark of Discharge
records.trigger:
3 minors/2 elites/1 miniboss+ arc weapon kills
ionic trace pickup
records.usage: helps with arc warlock ionic trace ability cycling, not extremely noticeable but additive benefit with high uptime

records.name: Whisper of Chains
records.trigger: 3 minors/2 elites/1 miniboss+ kill with Frost Armor (1?s ICD)
records.usage: good stasis builds don't really notice occasional extra shard, but free additive benefit

records.name: Facet of Command
records.effect:
refills readied weapon, 20? stability, ? AA, 40 AE for 11s
stasis shard/void breach
records.usage: has some interesting applications for micro-optimization for rotations, also has some neutral benefits

records.name: Echo of Domineering
records.effect:
refill, +30 Weapons, 4% forward movespeed for 10s
void breach
records.usage: interesting DPS applications for weapons like Truth and A499, also a breach source

records.name: Whisper of Durance
records.effect: slow and some stasis abilities get more duration (varies)
records.usage: sadly not really impactful on the best stasis builds, good on warlock and for some duration abilities like Squall

records.name: Facet of Ruin
records.effect:
extra staggering 25 damage 10m instance
ignitions gain 2m radius (1.25x)
records.usage: marginally helpful for Prismatic GPG, Consecration, and Bleak Watcher builds

records.name: Facet of Mending
records.usage: more incentive to run prismatic GPG over solar, but largely the same given poor lethality on prismatic grenades

records.name: Ember of Resolve
records.usage: solar grenade builds are too low uptime for this to really be useful, also only Cure x1

records.name: Whisper of Rending
records.effect: 2x primary damage to stasis crystals, 1.5x primary damage to frozen enemies
records.usage: strong damage increase but very niche situations for application (basically just Fighting Lion)

records.name: Echo of Reprisal
records.usage: actually very potent additive super farming effect, but high enemy requirement makes this an unlikely pick

records.name: Ember of Empyrean
records.usage: has issues with resetting some longer sources of Restoration, otherwise extension nerf hit pretty hard

records.name: Whisper of Refraction
records.usage: much easier requirement than Mind but class ability generally unneeded on stasis builds off hunter

records.name: Spark of Magnitude
records.effect: lightning grenade gets 1 more bolt, pulse grenade gets 2 more pulses, storm grenade gets additional strike (1.5s longer roam when enhanced)
records.usage: can be used with arc grenade spam builds, but they aren't really meta in current sandbox

records.name: Facet of Blessing
records.effect: health regen (applies to allies within ?m while transcendent)
records.usage: same issues as Leeching, allied benefit doesn't really do anything either, can bypass Brawn

records.name: Echo of Leeching
records.usage: health regen tends to be immediately interrupted in combat, can bypass Brawn

records.name: Echo of Cessation
records.usage: all benefits easy to obtain from artifact instead, finisher knockback is cool though

records.name: Facet of Sacrifice
records.usage: only transcendence fragment that really gets used given light ability spam frequency

records.name: Ember of Blistering
records.usage: ignition kills can be frequent but 8% for a T1 combatant is pretty terrible

records.name: Ember of Eruption
records.usage: honestly not that noticeable but not a bad filler fragment for ignition builds

records.name: Ember of Mercy
records.effect:
Restoration x1 for 2-3s (additive)
Restoration x1 for 5-7.5s to allies within ?m
records.usage: definitely helpful for weapon/firesprite-focused solar builds, not very meta though

records.name: Echo of Remnants
records.effect: axion bolt gets 1.?x duration, void spike/void wall gets 1.5x duration, vortex gets 1.25x duration (1.55x for enhanced)
records.usage: one of the least noticeable grenade duration fragments given current build meta

records.name: Echo of Provision
records.usage: most void melees are borderline useless, on-hit requirement is decent though

records.name: Spark of Amplitude
records.trigger: 2 kills within 4s of each while Amplified (10s ICD)
records.usage: one of the easiest free orb sources, still has 10s ICD though

records.name: Echo of Harvest
records.usage: easy conditions to meet for free orb/breach, but long ICD

records.name: Spark of Feedback
records.effect: +100% melee damage for next melee within 5s, not refreshable
records.usage: small situational additive damage bonus, still probably good on some arc melee builds but not essential

records.name: Facet of Awakening
records.trigger: 3 elemental kills within 6s of each or super kill (5s ICD)
records.usage: 3 kill requirement for one pickup, still has ICD, element requirement

records.name: Facet of Balance
records.trigger: 3 kills within 3?s of each with light/dark damage
records.usage: mediocre energy returns for triple kill requirement, still okay for neutral

records.name: Spark of Ions
records.usage: easy to activate on competent arc builds but ICD holds it back a lot

records.name: Ember of Combustion
records.usage: cool interaction with Well but useless otherwise

records.name: Whisper of Fractures
records.usage: unneeded extra Frost Armor source given artifact and raw crystal spam, unusable on other stasis builds

records.name: Whisper of Bonds
records.usage: not that hard to activate on stasis but still not great given stat drop and no pickup creation

records.name: Echo of Exchange
records.usage: void melee kills not very frequent, and returns aren't even that great

records.name: Ember of Wonder
records.trigger: 2 ignition kills within ?s of each (10s ICD)
records.usage: arguably worst condition + no pickup return of 10s ICD fragments

records.name: Facet of Grace
records.usage: acceptable with kinetic weapon builds but still not really that helpful, 2% isn't that much

records.name: Whisper of Chill
records.trigger: 3 minors/2 elites/1 miniboss+ stasis weapon kill (5?s ICD)
records.usage: ICD sucks especially when most stasis builds are ability-focused and not weapon-focused

records.name: Facet of Bravery
records.effect:
Volatile Rounds to void weapons for 11.25s
Unraveling Rounds to strand weapons for 11.25s
records.usage: artifact usually provides these benefits if correct mods are chosen

records.name: Echo of Instability
records.effect: Volatile Rounds to void weapons for 11.25s
records.usage: generally useless given likely artifact choice on void builds

records.name: Whisper of Fissures
records.usage: only potentially helpful for Bleak Watcher chain shatters, otherwise usually detrimental due to knockback

records.name: Echo of Expulsion
records.usage: would be good on other subclasses but void has trouble with refreshable single target ability kills

records.name: Facet of Justice
records.usage: strongly dependent on whether build can produce consistent ability kills without normal grenade

records.name: Thread of Rebirth
records.trigger: 3 minors/2 elites/1 miniboss+ strand weapon kills
records.usage: free extra threadlings but strand weapon requirement makes this much less appealing

records.name: Spark of Momentum
records.trigger: sliding over brick without full ammo
records.effect: equipped weapon refill, x3 Bolt Charge
records.usage: refills only one weapon, has to be played around, Bolt Charge benefit is whatever

records.name: Ember of Tempering
records.effect: 20 AE, 20/40/60 Health, firesprite on solar weapon kill to allies within 15m for 8s
records.usage: consistent firesprite source without ability conditions, other benefits are useless though

records.name: Thread of Propagation
records.effect: Unraveling Rounds to strand weapons for 8s
records.usage: same problem as Bravery, can be sourced from artifact easily

records.name: Thread of Wisdom
records.usage: one of the more annoying 10s ICD orb sources, especially given not all strand builds suspend

records.name: Thread of Mind
records.usage: poor uptime requirement for worst ability return choice

records.name: Facet of Devotion
records.usage: light transcendence generally not the missing energy type on transcendence-reliant builds

records.name: Facet of Honor
records.effect: 7.5% light transcendence (5% darkness for stasis shard, 10% darkness for tangle)
records.usage: desirable darkness energy sources not really available for builds that want transcendence uptime

records.name: Thread of Finality
records.usage: pretty poor returns unless build entirely revolves around finishers

records.name: Facet of Defiance
records.usage: pretty small radius, usefulness dependent on equipped super

records.name: Thread of Continuity
records.usage: unravel and suspend duration increases generally irrelevant, sever extension is nice but really significant

records.name: Ember of Beams
records.usage: questionable if this even does anything

records.name: Spark of Brilliance
records.usage: just worse than Beacons in every way

records.name: Echo of Dilation
records.effect: crouch speed set to 4m/s, enhanced radar
records.usage: basically just for stats

records.name: Whisper of Hedrons
records.usage: constant handling increase but realistically never worth the slot

records.name: Whisper of Reversal
records.trigger: dealing or receiving melee damage with Frost Armor
records.usage: basically useless defensive effect given melee damage requirement

records.name: Spark of Volts
records.usage: probably worst finisher fragment reward

records.name: Spark of Recharge
records.usage: strong regen effect but requirement is a non-starter for endgame

records.name: Thread of Transmutation
records.usage: tangles already being created as soon as global CD expires, doesn't really change anything

records.name: Spark of Focus
records.usage: terrible requirement for mediocre class regen

records.name: Spark of Instinct
records.trigger: taking damage at critical health (15?s ICD)
records.usage: worse ICD than Vigilance while providing a much worse effect

records.name: Thread of Binding
records.usage: insanely situational for what ends up being a pretty useless effect given super lethality

records.name: Spark of Haste
records.usage: Health only when running is laughable especially given most builds run 0 Health
